messages:
nora: dropped a compact mock for the key safety modal and batch actions: https://www.figma.com/file/XYZ999 (see /safety-modal). need quick takes on copy, guardrails, and keyboard behavior.

sam: nice layout. main concern: the modal mixes 'revoke' and 'delete' language. users will be confused. suggest explicit headings: 'Revoke (temporary, undoable)' and 'Delete (permanent)'.

lee: accessibility: ensure modal title receives initial focus. action button order should be primary -> secondary -> cancel for screen reader flow. undo toast needs aria-live and must be tabbable.

anya: copy tweak: change the big warning copy to: "Revoking disables the key immediately. You can restore it from Activity within 14 days." then a small link: "Permanently delete now". less scary, more precise.

mike: for org-level keys, recommend stronger guardrail: require typing the full key label to confirm. also surface an 'Affected services' summary (collapsed) with counts.

sam: batch rotate progress: show per-item chips with friendly states (Rotated, Skipped, Failed). for failures surface friendly explanations and a Retry per-row. no raw errors.

lee: keyboard flow for bulk modal: when opened via keyboard, focus should land on the modal title and Tab should go to the first actionable element. on small screens, the modal should be full screen and still trap focus.

anya: permission UX: if user lacks rights, instead of disabled controls show a small inline CTA: 'Request access' that opens a prefilled request modal. reduces dead-ends.

mike: question: default CTA for rotate options? 'Rotate and revoke old keys' vs 'Create rotated copies'. suggest detecting key type: default to revoke for user keys, copies for integration keys.

nora: plan: - normalize wording revoke vs delete - undo window 14d, toast 12s and tabbable - type-to-confirm for org/system keys - collapsed impacted services summary - inline request access flow. I'll update the mock and ping when ready.

infra-bot: Deploy queued: feature/keys-ux/safety-modal -> staging (build 520).

lee: I'll run a quick keyboard/a11y pass on staging once it's up and report any issues here.

nora: thanks everyone :raised_hands:
